As a Software Engineer, you will join our growing team and help build a next-generation medical imaging application that supports clinicians during interventional procedures.
This role is for a Software Engineer focused on C++ development within a large-scale strategic program of more than 100 professionals. You'll work day-to-day with modern C++, CMake, Conan2 and GitHub Enterprise, supported by AI-assisted engineering practices.
What excites you as a Senior Software Engineer?
From our Cluj-Napoca office, in Romania’s tech-driven second city, you join a vibrant IT scene.
The city blends startups, global firms, and top universities. You will fit our team if you like to:
Develop a next-generation medical imaging application in modern C++ that helps clinicians identify, visualize and measure vascular structures.
Work productively with Visual Studio 2022/2026 or VS Code, modern CMake and Conan2 package management.
Use GitHub Enterprise for version control and take part in an intensive triple-review process that safeguards code quality.
Apply AI-supported engineering practices, in your daily development work.
Contribute to a modern software architecture on a greenfield platform that consolidates existing legacy applications.
Collaborate with Product Owners, technical Product Owners and the customer's specialists in an agile setup with stand-ups, refinements, sprint demos and retrospectives.
 Sounds good so far? We'd love to tell you more…
Your future workplace
This is what you bring to the table
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, and 5–8 years of experience in software development.
Solid programming skills in modern C++ (C++17 or newer) and hands-on experience with modern CMake, Conan2 and Visual Studio 2022/2026 or VS Code.
Experience with modern software architecture and greenfield development.
Solid experience with Git/GitHub Enterprise; exposure to GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted development.
Affinity with medical devices or healthcare; experience in regulated environments or UI development is a plus.
A strong software engineering and code quality mindset, with experience in intensive peer reviews.
Strong analytical and communication skills, and an affinity for high-tech applications.
 This is what you can expect in return
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
A welcoming environment with opportunities for personal development and professional growth.
You'll work in a prime location with easy access to public transport and nearby amenities. The office’s innovative design and focus on well-being create a space where creativity and projects thrive.
Flexible 40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from
Christmas parties with Santa and families and rooftop parties, to inspiring knowledge sessions for the high-tech community.
Fun team-building activities.
 High Tech & High Fun
